'''D'Nica Jongales''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], Jongales was present in [[Vanster Enan's Cantina (Tolea Biqua franchise)|Vanster Enan's Cantina]].
